title: Please test out this free game I made with ai
author: PlaceholderTestAcc
selftext:
It is in beta, and so far barely any content, but I want to know what people think just of the concept. 

There are no saves, not much content in general.

Please tell me your thoughts, what you like, and what'd you wish to be able to see more of in a game like this.

I am aware of the balance issues, that'll be dealt with eventually,

https://mfcproductions.github.io/Sector-3/

comments.author: johnesco
comments.body:
Let's see.. ok, nice light beams... hmm   "close blast doors", neat. Let's go down the hallway and OPEN THE BLAST DOORS OPEN THE BLAST DOORS! 😄 

Seems like a good start. The separation of movement from aiming is a style I like.

comments.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
comments.body: If you have any queries or questions regarding this game or how to play, please feel free to ask me here!

comments.author: desederium
comments.body: I played for a few mins and liked it

comments.author: tophatmcbabs
comments.body:
# Signal lost

Crawlers swarmed the catwalk.

Survived **2:45** and put down **17** entities.

pretty cool games! personally, I love floating hit numbers and enemy health bars, but seeing as how this is a horror esque game, maybe it's better not to know enemy health; however, i still think floating hit numbers would be cool! 

did it have no sound / music? if so that would be desirable. other than that, i could foresee more levels, monsters, story, and weapons. 

  
cheers!

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: Thank you! Yes unfortunately there is no sound. I'm working on content first! Or at least... directing ai to do content first. Did you like the bag zip mechanic? I'd love to know!

replies.author: tophatmcbabs
replies.body: Omg I didn't even open the inventory! Let me tell what you happened.. I skimmed the instructions (lol), fought monsters, I ran out of bullets, frantically tried to find bullets, and eventually died lol. I think I would've figured that out after another round or 2 tho! I will say that I really liked the flash light visuals though! It's remarkable how far AI has come to be able to code this type of thing for us!

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: Yes. There are a few more mechanics too. The food system is relatively sophisticated. More sophisticated than an instant "consume" button at least...

replies.author: Alternative_Pie7322
replies.body: The zip bag mechanic is very cool!

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: Thank you! I'm glad you liked it :) Did you check out the food system? I think its relatively unique

comments.author: TheUniverseOrNothing
comments.body:
It’s not a bad start. Actually reminds me of the zombie game I played on phone that I loved. So if you build a solid gameplay loop I could see myself playing something like this.

Going to send you a DM I’m building a few games and would love to connect.

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: Thank you! What do you think could be added to make it a solid gaming loop? In hindsight some storage mechanic to put your stuff in the command room would've been nice... sure, I'd love to see what kind of games you have :)

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: Yea. I'm not going to make it paid(ever) it'll stay free. Ill make an update on this game if enough people here like it to see if anyone ever cares about my idea

comments.author: rectangle_so
comments.body:
pretty cool concept, I like it!!!

my quick thoughts were the "how to play" should be available when i pause  
why do you zip up the bag? is this a gameplay feature that will come into use later?   
how the heck do you get more ammo!

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body:
Thank you! Ill address your points one by one. 
1: Probrably fair enough, I'll establish an button for that in an update.
2: Zipping up the bag keeps items secure, if you just leave it open items may drop out. Don't worry, because you dont need to fully keep the bag closed. Whatever fully zipped in won't fall. 
3:Ammo is scattered across the map.

comments.author: FazedEclipse2
comments.body: I love the concept almost like a cross between five nights at freddies, Alien, and a survival sim. I'd even go as far as if you can get this to a good level of polish, I'd put the prototype to whoevers in charge of the alien franchise they might buy it from you

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: Your so kind with your words🥰 But how about feedback? What are some issues you have with the game? What do you want to see more of? I'd love to know!

replies.body: Do you really think my ideas that good tho? Like your serious?? Damn

comments.author: Such--Balance
comments.body:
forgot to read the instructions, didnt figure out how to eat or drink. Maybe have some visual ui on the screen the open the inventory as well.

Good looking game though. Killed some monsters

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: Hi！thanks for your input. To eat You need to Grab Instant noodles scattered around，Then scroll down，where you can see a button to unseal the lid. In your Base theres a water dispenser Where you need to put blue water in To boil，and you can then cook the instant noodles and put in the seasoning packets and enjoy！For drinking same thing，click on the water in your bag，and scroll down to find the drink button.

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body: You can also Just eat the instant noodless raw without Seasoning. Still feeds you，is quicker，but takes thirst

comments.author: Ok-Investment4414
comments.body: needs alot a work , walk movement and slight screen tilt would be nice , textures, better mobs , also i cannot pick up items :- / bag pack full idk how to empty it even though i needed helt.

replies.author: PlaceholderTestAcc
replies.body:
Hi！Thanks，i appreciate your feedback！ 
A few questions: 
How long did you play this game？ 
Are you Pc or Mobile？ 
How was the gameplay？did you encounter any of the mechanics 

Regarding your critique: Walk movement and slight screen tilt Will be Added in a future update，And about the better mobs？Definately，currently theyll a bit basic and not much you can do with them. Textures and quality im afraid wont change，Mostly because i dont have the budget AND that i prefer to work on gameplay rather than graphics. 

If your backpack is full you can press discard below The item description. You just need to scroll down while the bag is open
